lines.1: 「All right, the party's in full swing. Time for hidden talents!」
lines.2: 「Me first! Kinu Kanisawa, performing an impression!」
lines.4: 「Surrendering to the excitement of the moment is foolish... How pointless.」
lines.5: 「Ah, Princess! The Princess is so beautiful! I can't get enough! But I mustn't surrender to the excitement of the moment!」
lines.7: I grabbed Crab's cheek and pulled.
lines.10: 「It's hilarious because she's got you exactly!」
lines.11: 「She has captured your defining traits well.」
